# Psychology Times UK

> > Psychology Times UK is a comprehensive mental health platform connecting users with psychologists and publishing evidence-based psychology articles across clinical, forensic, and relationship domains.

Psychology Times UK serves as both a psychologist directory and content hub featuring articles by psychology professionals and academics. The site covers diverse psychological topics including trauma, relationships, criminal psychology, and child development, with contributions from experts in Analytical Psychology, Cognitive Psychology, and Personality Psychology.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health
- Trauma Psychology
- Couples Therapy
- Criminal Psychology
- Child Development
- Relationship Psychology
- Grief and Loss
- Psychologist Directory
- Analytical Psychology
- Cognitive Psychology
- PTSD
- Personality Psychology
- Crime Prevention
- Youth Behavior
- Psychological Safety

## Core Platform

- [Psychology Times UK | Connect with Psychologists (2026)](https://psychologytimes.co.uk): Homepage and psychologist directory for connecting with mental health professionals
- [About Us - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/aboutus): Platform mission, information, and site overview

## Relationship & Couples Psychology

- [What Is Couples Therapy? Frequently Asked Questions About Couples Therapy - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/what-is-couples-therapy-frequently-asked-questions-about-couples-therapy): Comprehensive FAQ guide to couples therapy, relationship counseling, and communication strategies
- [Why Are We Always Attracted To The Same People? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/why-are-we-always-attracted-to-the-same-people): Psychology of attraction patterns and romantic partner selection
- [Psychological Safety In Relationships: Why Love Is Not Enough - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/psychological-safety-in-relationships-why-love-is-not-enough): Emotional security and psychological safety as foundations beyond romantic love
- [Hidden Wounds In Relationships: The Psychology Of Silent Disengagement - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/hidden-wounds-in-relationships-the-psychology-of-silent-disengagement): Relationship dynamics, emotional withdrawal, and silent disengagement patterns

## Trauma, Grief & Mental Health

- [Growing Up In The Shadow Of War: Effects On Mental Health - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/growing-up-in-the-shadow-of-war-effects-on-mental-health): War trauma effects on childhood psychology and developmental mental health
- [Sudden Loss and Trauma: The Psychological Impact Of Unexpected Death - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/sudden-loss-and-trauma-the-psychological-impact-of-unexpected-death): Grief psychology, trauma responses, and bereavement following unexpected loss
- [From Trauma To Tests: How World War II Changed The Science Of Psychology - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/from-trauma-to-tests-how-world-war-ii-changed-the-science-of-psychology): WWII's impact on psychology: trauma, PTSD development, and psychological testing history
- [Night Stage: Are Nightmares The Mind's Alarm Or An Attempt To Heal? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/night-stage-are-nightmares-the-minds-alarm-or-an-attempt-to-heal): Nightmare psychology: trauma processing, healing mechanisms, and subconscious mind
- [Stress: Friend Or Enemy? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/stress-friend-or-enemy): Stress psychology: understanding stress as both adaptive challenge and threat response

## Criminal & Forensic Psychology

- [Desensitization In Offenders: A Psychological Trajectory From The Initial Crime To Serial Offending - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/desensitization-in-offenders-a-psychological-trajectory-from-the-initial-crime-to-serial-offending): Criminal psychology: desensitization mechanisms and progression toward serial offending
- [Children Drawn Into Crime: Offender Or Victim? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/children-drawn-into-crime-offender-or-victim): Juvenile crime psychology: child offenders, victimization, and crime prevention
- [Women Who Offend: A Gendered Perspective On Crime - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/women-who-offend-a-gendered-perspective-on-crime): Female offending patterns: gendered criminology and criminal psychology analysis
- [Not Prone To Crime, Raising Healthy Generations - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/not-prone-to-crime-raising-healthy-generations): Youth crime prevention: child development psychology and healthy generation outcomes

## Personality, Family & Development Psychology

- [Is The Child Of A Narcissistic Parent Also Narcissistic? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/is-the-child-of-a-narcissistic-parent-also-narcissistic): Narcissistic parenting effects on child personality development and trait inheritance
- [The Self Forced To Succeed: A Psychoanalytic Perspective On Test Anxiety In Turkey - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/the-self-forced-to-succeed-a-psychoanalytic-perspective-on-test-anxiety-in-turkey): Test anxiety in Turkey: psychoanalytic analysis of academic pressure and self-concept

## Literary & Analytical Psychology

- [The Hidden Psychodynamics Of Seven Dials Mystery: Grief, Destruction, And The Struggle For Individuation - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/the-hidden-psychodynamics-of-seven-dials-mystery-grief-destruction-and-the-struggle-for-individuation): Jungian analysis of Seven Dials Mystery: individuation, grief, and psychological symbolism
- [Did Everything Really Start With A Bag? - Psychology Times](https://psychologytimes.co.uk/did-everything-really-start-with-a-bag): Literary psychology analysis of Museum of Innocence and self-worth themes
